styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a small side-view cafe chair with a red seat and a dark grey-blue back. It has only 9 distinct colours, against 14 for the bench, 11 for the hedge and 38-40 for the stall and well. Its 17% flat-fill coverage is above the bench, hedge, lamp and well (all 0%) and above the stall's 13%. The red seat and the back panel are mostly single flat tones with only a highlight or shadow edge, so each material has about 3 steps against roughly 5 on the references. The outline is tinted (only 13% of dark edge pixels are neutral), so it reads as dark material tone rather than a black sticker line. The tile median of 8 is close to the hedge's 10, but the chair has no grain, tufts or per-part shading. Placed next to the bench, which has per-slat shading, it looks flatter and thinner. When in doubt, fail.
